description: A quality director must decide the disposition of a 2,400-unit batch of zinc-coated fasteners after a curing-oven temperature alarm and finalize the rework, testing, segregation, and customer-documentation controls.

shared_context.S1: A batch of 2,400 zinc-coated fasteners is on quality hold after a curing oven temperature alarm during the batch run.
shared_context.S2: Mara makes the binding disposition decision for the batch.
shared_context.S3: The fasteners must not be shipped or returned to production until the quality hold is formally resolved.
shared_context.S4: The plant's normal end-of-shift disposition huddle includes a formal fact-recording step: the process, laboratory, logistics, and customer-compliance owners each record and announce their update before Mara closes a held batch.

PF1.text: Jonas reviewed the oven recorder and tray map after the alarm: exactly 700 fasteners from trays P17 through P23 were exposed during the out-of-range period, while the other 1,700 fasteners were within the approved cure profile. The affected 700 can be re-cured in Oven 2 for exactly 2 hours; he has not yet attached this review to the batch record.

PF2.text: Priya's coating evaluation found that re-cured fasteners require a salt-spray confirmation using exactly 20 sample pieces before release; this requirement came from the coating laboratory's method review this afternoon but is not yet on the hold checklist.

PF3.text: Caleb verified that pallets P17, P18, P19, P20, P21, P22, and P23 are physically isolated in the marked quarantine lane, while P1 through P16 contain the unaffected fasteners; the pallet-location verification has not yet been entered in the warehouse system.

PF4.text: Nadia confirmed in the customer's quality portal that any re-cured fasteners require a customer concession and a Certificate of Conformance identifying the re-cure; she has not yet added the portal confirmation to the customer file.

acceptance_conditions: Exactly 1,700 unaffected fasteners must be released.
Exactly 700 fasteners must be assigned to rework and none may be rejected.
The affected fasteners must be re-cured in Oven 2 for exactly 2 hours.
The re-cured fasteners must receive a salt-spray confirmation using exactly 20 sample pieces.
Pallets P17 through P23 must remain explicitly segregated from the released material.
A customer concession and a Certificate of Conformance identifying the re-cure must be required.

decisive_facts.why: The recorder review changes the disposition from an undifferentiated hold to exactly 1,700 released and 700 reworked, and fixes the rework at Oven 2 for exactly 2 hours.
The laboratory method review changes the release test to exactly 20 salt-spray samples.
The pallet verification changes the segregation assignment to exactly pallets P17, P18, P19, P20, P21, P22, and P23.
The customer portal confirmation changes the documentation plan by requiring both a customer concession and a Certificate of Conformance identifying the re-cure.
